notes: Regression suite for the code-review skill. Each eval feeds the listed file(s) to a reviewer that has read SKILL.md, with the given prompt. `expectations` are the design points a good review should surface. Baseline (no skill) reference: on these cases a strong model already finds most issues; the skill's measured value is consistency across dimensions, calibration on good code (not flagging integer overflow / not gold-plating Money), and the clean-evolution stance (delete the legacy path rather than preserve it).

evals.prompt: Can you review this PHP class for me?
evals.expected_output: Design review leading with the shallow-because-primitives problem.
expectations: Flags getSubtotal/getCurrency as shallow pass-through methods (§1)
Flags the nullable ?array/?string params as pushing special cases onto callers (§2)
Flags the discount-type / tax-region if+ternary branching as leaked special cases (§2)
Recommends value objects instead of raw array/string/float (§5)
Proposes an always-present Discount / Null Object so the null branch disappears (§2)

evals.prompt: Can you do a design review of this class?
evals.expected_output: Review covering what-comments, member ordering, naming/namespace, value objects.
expectations: Flags the what-comments that restate the code (§3)
Flags member ordering: helpers on top, send() buried, constructor last (§6)
Flags the type-first App\Model namespace and/or the vague Manager name (§4)
Recommends value objects for the string channel/recipient (§5)
Recommends a class-level why-comment or @see link (§3)

evals.expected_output: Calibration case: recognizes a deep, well-designed VO; stays minor; does NOT flag integer overflow.
expectations: Recognizes Money as a deep, immutable, well-designed value object (§1/§5)
Approves the class-level why-comment rather than asking to remove it (§3)
Does NOT flag integer overflow as a problem (calibration)
Keeps suggestions minor/calibrated — no manufactured redesign or gold-plating

evals.prompt: We added the new layout a while ago but kept the old one behind a flag. Can you review this class?
evals.expected_output: Review that says delete the legacy path, use an enum, type the report; also catches the XSS.
expectations: Recommends DELETING the old layout path / refactoring rather than keeping the $useLegacyLayout flag (§7)
Flags mixed and the untyped $options / @param-only typing and recommends explicit or union types (§7)
Recommends an enum for $format instead of magic strings with if/elseif fallthrough (§7/§2)
Flags the raw array $report primitive and suggests a typed Report / value object (§5)
Surfaces the unescaped-HTML XSS as a blocking bug (blocking-bugs-first)

evals.prompt: Review this loyalty points code and its test.
evals.expected_output: Review identifying the anemic model, tier enum, and the mock-mirroring test.
expectations: Identifies the anemic model: award/points logic belongs on Customer, not a service reaching in (§5)
Flags the mutable Customer (public props + setters) and recommends immutability / encapsulation (§5)
Recommends an enum/value object for the tier and flags the rate if/elseif branching (§2/§7)
Flags the test as mock-heavy / mirroring the implementation rather than end-to-end (§8)
